title: Organization-ledger component parameters (one file per consuming organization)
description: DRAFT. Parameter names are taken from InTr H29 §2.2 (StegVerse-org/.github#163 issuecomment-6234609427); #163 wins on naming, and these are those names. Fields marked derived must not be typed; the component computes them and refuses a typed override. Dispatch-time inputs (hb_epoch, communication_id, packet_id) are never stored here.

designation_source.description: H29 #9. The #163 comment or request_id that adopts this organization.

repository_ledger_designation_source.description: Optional. Repository-level designation string; defaults to designation_source.

repository_ledger_rule.description: Optional. Overrides the template rule text (StegVerse-org's text by default).

propagation_target.description: H29 #10. Default master-records/.github. Downstream recorder only; never gates (propagation_gates_organization_runtime_reality is fixed false). OWNER DECISION for master-records itself.

organization_record_service_declared.description: H29 #12. When false, the contract records DENY_ORGANIZATION_RECORD_SERVICE_NOT_DECLARED_FOR_THE_PROPAGATION_TARGET (StegGhost precedent).

owning_existing_goal.description: H29 #19. Carried on every six-field non-ALLOW the component emits for this organization.

test_modules.description: H29 #20. Defaults to the component suite; per-org tests are additive only.

install_step.description: H29 #21. Stdlib only. Request mode installs only the pinned SDK (an existing dependency).

x-derived-never-typed.organization_slug: H29 #2. kernel.organization_slug(organization). Must equal the federation row's org_control_service prefix.
x-derived-never-typed.capability_endpoint_bindings[intr-destin: H29 #13. Fixed body owned by InTr & Mesh. Generated with owner_repository and addressed_service substituted.

x-dispatch-inputs-never-stored.hb_epoch: H29 #15. Digits only, >= 32 (HB_ANCHOR_EPOCH). Required on every append, on both repo and org receipts. No clock fallback.
x-dispatch-inputs-never-stored.communication_id: H29 #16. Required for self-closure. Default convention intr-selfclose-<organization>-HB<hb_epoch>.
x-dispatch-inputs-never-stored.packet_id: H29 #17. Default intr-destination-self-closure:<communication_id>, which makes redelivery idempotent.
